header.title: Control Plane
header.staleAria: Live updates interrupted; the board may be out of date

queue.title: Task queue
queue.caption: Tasks known to the control plane.
queue.emptyBody: Task data will appear here when a runtime source is connected.

timeline.title: Execution timeline
timeline.empty: Select a task to inspect its state transitions.

inspector.title: Task inspector
inspector.emptyBody: Select a queue record to inspect evidence and usage.

approval.title: Waiting on you
approval.body: This run stopped for a human decision. Approving records who decided; it does not restart the run.
approval.failed: The decision was not recorded. Nothing changed.

table.title: Recorded actions
table.caption: Actions recorded by the control plane and by authentication.
table.emptyBody: Task submissions, approval decisions, and sign-ins appear here as they are made.

error.title: The audit log could not be read
error.forbidden: Reading the audit log requires the admin role. Ask an administrator for access.
error.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again to read the audit log.
error.generic: The audit log is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

authNotice.forbidden: Authentication events are not listed: reading them requires owning or administering the organizations this account belongs to.
authNotice.generic: Authentication events are temporarily unavailable; the control-plane trail is complete.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Shortcuts are ignored while you are typing in a field.

newTask.title: New task
newTask.note: The run starts once the control plane has capacity.
newTask.failed: The task was not created. Check the path, the mode, and what your credentials allow.

error.title: The settings could not be read
error.forbidden: Managing the deployment settings requires the admin role. Ask an administrator for access.
error.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again to see the settings.
error.generic: The settings are temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

invalid.title: The settings are invalid
invalid.body: No task can start until every issue below is fixed.

source.title: Source
source.fileHint: Read-only here. Edit this file on the server and restart Code Zero to apply a change.
source.dashboardHint: Stored in the database and edited on this page. A saved change applies to the next task that starts.
source.cloudHint: The managed service runs the AI provider, the sandbox, the database and mail. They cannot be changed here.
source.switchHint: The source is chosen with CODE_ZERO_SETTINGS_SOURCE when the server starts.

hints.maxConcurrentTasks: Tasks this deployment runs at once; the rest wait in the queue. From {min} to {max}.
hints.commandTimeoutMinutes: Minutes before one repository command is stopped. Not a limit on a whole run, which can run several commands. From {min} to {max}.
hints.allowedModes: Observe is always allowed: it never writes.
hints.maxNetwork: The widest network access any run may have. A repository may narrow it, never widen it.
hints.model: The provider's credentials stay in the server environment.
hints.runner: Only container isolation can be enforced from here.

form.saved: Settings saved. The next task that starts uses them.
form.invalid: Some values were refused. Fix the marked fields and save again.
form.forbidden: You are not allowed to change these settings.
form.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again, then save.
form.precondition: The service settings are invalid, so these limits cannot be saved right now.
form.generic: The settings could not be saved. Try again in a moment.

services.title: Services
services.caption: Only whether each service is configured. Credentials, hosts and providers are never shown.

export.title: Export
export.body: The settings as the YAML config.yml would hold. Secrets are never included.
export.unavailable: Fix the invalid settings to export them.
export.copyFailed: The YAML could not be copied. Use the download instead.
export.error: The settings could not be exported. Try again in a moment.

plan.title: Plan limits
plan.caption: The ceiling for every organization on this plan.
plan.unavailable: The plan's limits are unavailable right now, so no task can start until the service is restored.

organization.title: Organization limits
organization.caption: Stricter limits for this organization's own tasks. They can never exceed the plan.
organization.none: Select an organization to see its limits.
organization.invalid: The stored limits are invalid, so this organization's tasks cannot start until they are saved again.
organization.emptyUsesPlan: Leave empty to use the plan's value.
organization.restrictModes: Allow fewer modes than the plan
organization.readOnly: Only an organization owner or admin can change these limits.
organization.saved: Limits saved. The next task this organization starts uses them.
organization.effectiveCaption: What this organization's tasks are held to: the plan, lowered by the limits above.
